Edit the declaration, not this file.\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS \"books\" (\"id\" INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, \"title\" TEXT NOT NULL, \"author\" TEXT NOT NULL);\n---\n=== app_server/__init__.py\n\"\"\"Flask application factory for the ReadingList web application.\"\"\"\n\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nfrom flask import Flask\n\nfrom persistence import open_database\n\nfrom .books import bp as books_bp\nfrom .settings import Settings\n\nTEMPLATE_FOLDER = Path(__file__).resolve().parent / \"templates\"\n\n\ndef create_app() -> Flask:\n    \"\"\"Build and return the ReadingList Flask application.\n\n    Opening the store does not connect to it; connections are made on first use, per thread.\n    \"\"\"\n    settings = Settings.from_environment()\n    app = Flask(__name__, template_folder=str(TEMPLATE_FOLDER))\n    app.extensions[\"database\"] = open_database(settings.database_url)\n    app.register_blueprint(books_bp)\n    return app\n=== app_server/book_service.py\n\"\"\"Book behavior for the ReadingList web application, free of any Flask dependency.\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom persistence import Database\nfrom persistence.schema import BookRow\n\n\nclass BookRejected(ValueError):\n    \"\"\"A submission the application refuses to store; ``reason`` says why and ``field`` names the input.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self, reason: str, field: str) -> None:\n        super().__init__(reason)\n        self.reason = reason\n        self.field = field\n\n\nclass BookNotFound(LookupError):\n    \"\"\"A removal named an id that no stored book carries; ``book_id`` is that id.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self, book_id: int) -> None:\n        super().__init__(book_id)\n        self.book_id = book_id\n\n\ndef add_book(database: Database, title: str, author: str) -> BookRow:\n    \"\"\"Store a book appended after every existing book and return the stored row.\n\n    Values are expected already trimmed by the caller. An empty title or author is refused\n    without touching the store, so a stored book always has both.\n    \"\"\"\n    if not title:\n        raise BookRejected(\"rejected: title is empty\", field=\"title\")\n    if not author:\n        raise BookRejected(\"rejected: author is empty\", field=\"author\")\n    return database.books.create(title=title, author=author)\n\n\ndef list_books(database: Database) -> list[BookRow]:\n    \"\"\"Return every stored book in the order added, oldest first.\n\n    The order is enforced here, by ascending id, rather than trusted to the store's select, which\n    the generated persistence layer issues without an ORDER BY clause.\n    \"\"\"\n    return sorted(database.books.list(), key=lambda row: row.id)\n\n\ndef remove_book(database: Database, book_id: int) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Delete the stored book with ``book_id``; the remaining books keep their order.\n\n    An id that no stored book carries is refused An empty title or author is refused\n    without touching the store, so a stored book always has both.\n    \"\"\"\n    if not title:\n        raise BookRejected(\"rejected: title is empty\", field=\"title\")\n    if not author:\n        raise BookRejected(\"rejected: author is empty\", field=\"author\")\n    return database.books.create(title=title, author=author)\n\n\ndef list_books(database: Database) -> list[BookRow]:\n    \"\"\"Return every stored book in the order added, oldest first.\n\n    The order is enforced here, by ascending id, rather than trusted to the store's select, which\n    the generated persistence layer issues without an ORDER BY clause.\n    \"\"\"\n    return sorted(database.books.list(), key=lambda row: row.id)\n\n\ndef remove_book(database: Database, book_id: int) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Delete the stored book with ``book_id``; the remaining books keep their order.\n\n    An id that no stored book carries is refused with ``BookNotFound`` before any write, so an\n    unknown id never changes stored data.\n    \"\"\"\n    if database.books.get(id=book_id) is None:\n        raise BookNotFound(book_id)\n    database.books.delete(id=book_id)\n=== app_server/books.py\n\"\"\"HTTP routes for books: add a book, list stored books in the order added, and remove a book.\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import test_surrounding_whitespace_is_trimmed_before_storing(app):\n    app.test_client().post(\"/books\", data={\"title\": \"  Dune \\t\", \"author\": \"\\n Frank Herbert  \"})\n\n    assert _stored(app) == assert _stored(app) == [(\"Dune  Messiah\", \"Frank  Herbert\")]\n\n\ndef test_new_book_is_appended_after_existing_books(app):\n    client = app.test_client()\n    client.post(\"/books\", {"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-haiku-5-5","id":"msg_011CgKNw1Wcoiwfmeh4HWuBd","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01M3n3cXpxD6vtf2W28r3H2r","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/mnt/c/Users/barlo/projects/drydock/uat/ReadingList/runs/20261023.144538/build/ReadingList/tests/test_reading_list_page.py","content":"\"\"\"Reading list page: GET / renders the add form, the books in the order added, and the remove controls.\"\"\"\n\nfrom html.parser import HTMLParser\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nimport pytest\n\nfrom app_server import create_app\nfrom app_server.book_service import add_book, remove_book\n\nPROJECT_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent\nJSON_ACCEPT = {\"Accept\": \"application/json\"}\n\n\n@pytest.fixture\ndef app(monkeypatch, tmp_path):\n    \"\"\"A fresh application over its own store, so no test touches the configured data/app.db.\"\"\"\n    store = tmp_path / \"reading-list-page.db\"\n    monkeypatch.setenv(\"DATABASE_URL\", f\"sqlite:///{store}\")\n    monkeypatch.delenv(\"DATABASE_PATH\", raising=False)\n    application = create_app()\n    application.extensions[\"database\"].execute_script((PROJECT_ROOT / \"schema.sql\").read_text())\n    return application\n\n\nclass _Page(HTMLParser):\n    \"\"\"Collects the forms, the list items, and the text of every role=\"alert\" element.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self) -> None:\n        super().__init__()\n        self.forms: list[dict] = []\n        self.inputs: list[dict] = []\n        self.items: list[dict] = []\n        self.alerts: list[str] = []\n        self.buttons: list[str] = []\n        self._form: dict | None = None\n        self._item: dict | None = None\n        self._alert_depth = 0\n        self._alert_text: list[str] = []\n        self._button_text: list[str] | None = None\n\n    def handle_starttag(self, tag, attrs):\n        attributes = dict(attrs)\n        if self._alert_depth:\n            self._alert_depth += 1\n        elif attributes.get(\"role\") == \"alert\":\n            self._alert_depth = 1\n            self._alert_text = []\n        if tag == \"form\":\n            self._form = {\"method\": attributes.get(\"method\"), \"action\": attributes.get(\"action\"), \"inputs\": []}\n            self.forms.append(self._form)\n        elif tag == \"input\":\n            self.inputs.append(attributes)\n            if self._form is not None:\n                self._form[\"inputs\"].append(attributes)\n        elif tag == \"li\":\n            self._item = {\"title\": \"\", \"author\": \"\", \"action\": None}\n            self.items.append(self._item)\n        elif tag == \"button\":\n            self._button_text = []\n        elif tag == \"span\" and self._item is not None:\n            self._item[\"_field\"] = attributes.get(\"class\")\n        if tag == \"form\" and self._item is not None:\n            self._item[\"action\"] = attributes.get(\"action\")\n\n    def handle_endtag(self, tag):\n        if self._alert_depth:\n            self._alert_depth -= 1\n            if self._alert_depth == 0:\n                self.alerts.append(\"\".join(self._alert_text))\n        if tag == \"form\":\n            self._form = None\n        elif tag == \"li\":\n            self._item = None\n        elif tag == \"button\" and self._button_text is not None:\n            self.buttons.append(\"\".join(self._button_text).strip())\n            self._button_text = None\n\n    def handle_data(self, data):\n        if self._alert_depth:\n            self._alert_text.append(data)\n        if self._button_text is not None:\n            self._button_text.append(data)\n        if self._item is not None and self._item.get(\"_field\"):\n            field = self._item.pop(\"_field\")\n            self._item[field] += data.strip()\n            self._item[\"_field\"] = None\n\n\ndef _parse(html: str) -> _Page:\n    page = _Page()\n    page.feed(html)\n    page.close()\n    return page\n\n\ndef _listed_titles(page: _Page) -> list[str]:\n    return [item[\"title\"] for item in page.items]\n\n\ndef test_index_answers_200_with_html(app):\n    response = app.test_client().get(\"/\")\n\n    assert response.status_code == 200\n    assert response.mimetype == \"text/html\"\n\n\ndef test_index_on_empty_store_shows_empty_state_and_no_list_items(app):\n    page = _parse(app.test_client().get(\"/\").get_data(as_text=True))\n\n    assert page.items == []\n    assert page.alerts == []\n\n\ndef test_index_lists_books_in_the_order_added(app):\n    database = app.extensions[\"database\"]\n    for title in [\"First\", \"Second\", \"Third\"]:\n        add_book(database, title=title, author=\"Order Author\")\n\n    page = _parse(app.test_client().get(\"/\").get_data(as_text=True))\n\n    assert _listed_titles(page) == [\"First\", \"Second\", \"Third\"]\n\n\ndef test_index_shows_each_book_author(app):\n    add_book(app.extensions[\"database\"], title=\"Dune\", author=\"Frank Herbert\")\n\n    page = _parse(app.test_client().get(\"/\").get_data(as_text=True))\n\n    assert [item[\"author\"] for item in page.items] == [\"Frank Herbert\"]\n\n\ndef test_index_lists_one_book_when_exactly_one_is_stored(app):\n    add_book(app.extensions[\"database\"], title=\"Only\", author=\"Solo\")\n\n    page =    client.post(\"/books\", data={\"title\": \"Dune\", \"author\": \"Frank Herbert\"})\n\n    page = _parse(client.get(\"/\").get_data(as_text=True))\n\n    assert _listed_titles(page) == database = app.extensions[\"database\"]\n    first = add_book(database, title=\"First\", author=\"A\").id\n    second = add_book(database, title=\"Second\", author=\"B\").id\n\n    page = _parse(app.test_client().get(\"/\").get_data(as_text=True))\n\n    remove_actions = [item[\"action\"] for item in page.items]\n    assert remove_actions == [f\"/books/{first}/delete\", f\"/books/{second}/delete\"]\n    for item in page.items:\n        assert item[\"action\"] is not None\n\n\ndef test_index_remove_control_is_a_post_form(app):\n    add_book(app.extensions[\"database\"], title=\"Dune\", author=\"Frank Herbert\")\n\n    page = _parse(app.test_client().get(\"/\").get_data(as_text=True))\n\n    remove_forms = [form for form in page.forms if form[\"action\"] and form[\"action\"].endswith(\"/delete\")]\n    assert len(remove_forms) == 1\n    assert remove_forms[0][\"method\"] == \"post\"\n    assert \"Remove\" in page.buttons\n\n\ndef test_index_has_no_remove_control_when_no_books_exist(app):\n    page = _parse(app.test_client().get(\"/\").get_data(as_text=True))\n\n    assert [form for form in page.forms if form[\"action\"] and form[\"action\"].endswith(\"/delete\")] == []\n\n\ndef test_index_after_removal_no_longer_lists_the_removed_book(app):\n    database = app.extensions[\"database\"]\n    keep = add_book(database, title=\"Keep\", author=\"A\").id\n    drop = add_book(database, title=\"Drop\", author=\"B\").id\n    remove_book(database, drop)\n\n    page = _parse(app.test_client().get(\"/\").get_data(as_text=True))\n\n    assert _listed_titles(page) == [\"Keep\"]\n    assert [item[\"action\"] for item in page.items] == [f\"/books/{keep}/delete\"]\n\n\ndef test_index_escapes_book_titles(app):\n    add_book(app.extensions[\"database\"], title=\"<b>bold</b>\", author=\"A\")\n\n    html = app.test_client().get(\"/\").get_data(as_text=True)\n\n    assert \"<b>bold</b>\" not in html\n    assert _listed_titles(_parse(html)) == [\"<b>bold</b>\"]\n\n\ndef test_rejected_html_submission_rerenders_page_with_reason_and_stored_books(app):\n    client = app.test_client()\n    client.post(\"/books\", data={\"title\": \"Dune\", \"author\": \"Frank Herbert\"})\n\n    response = client.post(\"/books\", data={\"title\": \"\", \"author\": \"Nobody\"})\n    page = _parse(response.get_data(as_text=True))\n\n    assert response.status_code == 400\n    assert response.mimetype == \"text/html\"\n    assert page.alerts == [\"rejected: title is empty\"]\n    assert _listed_titles(page) == [\"Dune\"]\n    assert any(form[\"action\"] == \"/books\" for form in page.forms)\n\n\ndef test_rejected_author_submission_shows_author_reason_on_page(app):\n    response = app.test_client().post(\"/books\", data={\"title\": \"Dune\", \"author\": \" \"})\n\n    assert _parse(response.get_data(as_text=True)).alerts == [\"rejected: author is empty\"]\n\n\ndef test_index_has_no_alert_when_nothing_was_rejected(app):\n    page = _parse(app.test_client().get(\"/\").get_data(as_text=True))\n\n    assert page.alerts == []\n\n\ndef test_index_keeps_working_after_rejection(app):\n    client = app.test_client()\n    client.post(\"/books\", data={\"title\": \"\", \"author\": \"Nobody\"})\n\n    response = client.get(\"/\")\n\n    assert response.status_code == 200\n    assert _parse(response.get_data(as_text=True)).alerts == []\n\n\ndef test_rejected_json_submission_still_answers_json_not_page(app):\n    response = app.test_client().post(\n        \"/books\", data={\"title\": \"\", \"author\": \"Nobody\"}, headers=JSON_ACCEPT\n    )\n\n    assert response.mimetype == \"application/json\"\n    assert response.get_json()[\"field\"] == \"schema.sql\").read_text())\n    return application\n\n\nclass _Page(HTMLParser):\n    \"\"\"Collects the forms, the list items, and the text of every role=\"alert\" element.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self) -> None:\n        super().__init__()\n        self.forms: list[dict] = []\n        self.inputs: list[dict] = []\n        self.items: list[dict] = []\n        self.alerts: list[str] = []\n        self.buttons: list[str] = []\n        self._form: dict | None = None\n        self._item: dict | None = None\n        self._alert_depth = 0\n        self._alert_text: list[str] = []\n        self._button_text: list[str] | None = None\n\n    def handle_starttag(self, tag, attrs):\n        attributes = dict(attrs)\n        if self._alert_depth:\n            self._alert_depth += 1\n        elif attributes.get(\"role\") == \"alert\":\n            self._alert_depth = 1\n            self._alert_text = []\n        if tag == \"form\":\n            self._form = {\"method\": attributes.get(\"method\"), \"action\": attributes.get(\"action\"), \"inputs\": []}\n            self.forms.append(self._form)\n        elif tag == \"input\":\n            self.inputs.append(attributes)\n            if self._form is not None:\n                self._form[\"inputs\"].append(attributes)\n        elif tag == \"li\":\n            self._item = {\"title\": \"\", \"author\": \"\", \"action\": None}\n            self.items.append(self._item)\n        elif tag == \"button\":\n            self._button_text = []\n        elif tag == \"span\" and self._item is not None:\n            self._item[\"_field\"] = attributes.get(\"class\")\n        if tag == \"form\" and self._item is not None:\n            self._item[\"action\"] = attributes.get(\"action\")\n\n    def handle_endtag(self, tag):\n        if self._alert_depth:\n            self._alert_depth -= 1\n            if self._alert_depth == 0:\n                self.alerts.append(\"\".join(self._alert_text))\n        if tag == \"form\":\n            self._form = None\n        elif tag == \"li\":\n            self._item = None\n        elif tag == \"button\" and self._button_text is not None:\n            self.buttons.append(\"\".join(self._button_text).strip())\n            self._button_text = None\n\n    def handle_data(self, data):\n        if self._alert_depth:\n            self._alert_text.append(data)\n        if self._button_text is not None:\n            self._button_text.append(data)\n        if self._item is not None and self._item.get(\"_field\"):\n            field = self._item.pop(\"_field\")\n            self._item[field] += data.strip()\n            self._item[\"_field\"] = None\n\n\ndef _parse(html: str) -> _Page:\n    page = _Page()\n    page.feed(html)\n    page.close()\n    return page\n\n\ndef _listed_titles(page: _Page) -> list[str]:\n    return [item[\"title\"] for item in page.items]\n\n\ndef test_index_answers_200_with_html(app):\n    response = app.test_client().get(\"/\")\n\n    assert response.status_code == 200\n    assert response.mimetype == \"text/html\"\n\n\ndef test_index_on_empty_store_shows_empty_state_and_no_list_items(app):\n    page = _parse(app.test_client().get(\"/\").get_data(as_text=True))\n\n    assert page.items == []\n    assert page.alerts == []\n\n\ndef test_index_lists_books_in_the_order_added(app):\n    database = app.extensions[\"database\"]\n    for title in [\"First\", \"Second\", \"Third\"]:\n        add_book(database, title=title, author=\"Order Author\")\n\n    page = _parse(app.test_client().get(\"/\").get_data(as_text=True))\n\n    assert _listed_titles(page) == [\"First\", \"Second\", \"Third\"]\n\n\ndef page.forms if form[\"action\"] == \"/books\"]\n    assert len(add_forms) == 1\n    assert add_forms[0][\"method\"] == \"post\"\n    names = {attributes.get(\"name\") for attributes in form[\"action\"] and form[\"action\"].endswith(\"/delete\")] == []\n\n\ndef test_index_after_removal_no_longer_lists_the_removed_book(app):\n    database = app.extensions[\"database\"]\n    keep = test_rejected_html_submission_rerenders_page_with_reason_and_stored_books(app):\n    client = app.test_client()\n    client.post(\"/books\", data={\"title\": \"Dune\", \"author\": \"Frank
